body:
I have long experience with drugs that my body became tolerant to, specific drugs like Tramadol and Hash that I smoked for 11 years and also used to drink three 8% beer 'Meister Max' 17 oz. for 3 years straight. However, my recent experience occurred twice in a row.
On the 16th I took 225 mg 'Pregabalin' + 12.5 mg Tianeptine, 7 hours later another 300 mg Pregabalin + 25 mg Tianeptine, which made me very talkative and hyperactive. Then 1 hour later I smoked 2 Hash  (Hashish) joints with two friends and I was feeling great so far, then 5 hour later I added 150 mg Pregabalin and smoked a Hash joint by myself and once I smoked it I felt severe dizziness so that when I moved my head back or forward my whole body swung with it.
once I smoked it I felt severe dizziness so that when I moved my head back or forward my whole body swung with it.
Five minutes later I couldn't sit down and had to lay down like if I have an overdose but without drop in blood pressure, I assume, because I wasn't sweating or even felt like an overdose, 'I had many when I was younger' so I can tell the difference, but this one was more like unpleasant severe dizziness or lightheadedness and I was forced to sleep and wake up 4 hours later.
However that day i didn't take any Baclofen at any time, but the next day I started with it instead of Pregabalin. I took 25 mg Baclofen and 12.5 mg Tianeptine and I was feeling so good by this combination  without the depression Pregabalin causes, but 8 hours later I took 25 mg Tianeptine + 35 mg Baclofen + just 150 mg Pregabalin and smoked a big Hash joint with two friends but I was ok and feeling good and having fun. However after they left I smoked a small Hash joint and right after this I went through the same severe dizziness and fell a sleep to wake up 4 hours later.
Conclusion: Pregabalin + Hash caused me severe unpleasant dizziness that forced me to lie down and fall asleep not happy.
Also Pregabalin + Tianeptine made me so talkative and hyperactive that I went to my mother's kitchen and started cleaning all of it :D something I never did in my life before.
